reference_rtl: rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_capture_parent/ot_hdc_core_v41x.sv (+ ot_chip_v41x_tile.sv, ot_v41_rt_die_l20_c8.sv: FULL_SHAPE 1, X_ROM 1, SUN 256, SUM 64, HHW 8, VM_AW 19, ROM_R 128): the S81 hub slabs are a physical partition of this core

common_rules.transport: every die bus is a valid-only stream: hub end blocks (ot_meso_fifo / ot_ratio_cdc_fifo) deliver {data, valid} in the receiver's clock; the only die-level flow control is a start block's 3-b status {0, w_live, w_rdy} (xes/xws/qNEs..). A receiving slab accepts one word every cycle and never drops.
common_rules.boundary: every slab is register-to-register: each die input bit is captured in a flop at its pin, each die output bit is launched from a flop at its pin (OWNER 2026-10-06 addendum); slab-internal wires > ~400 um get a register stage.
common_rules.framing: hub buses carry typed in-band frames, no width change: a header beat {type 4, tag 8, op 8, len 12, ...payload} followed by len data beats; the receiver knows the frame length from the header. Types: 1 op descriptor, 2 operand/data beat, 3 result beat, 4 done/status (tag, fault code), 5 fault. Units never stall on their own data (the core's rule: every unit is a fixed pipeline); the VM sequencer issues a unit op only when its wait mask has drained, exactly as ot_hdc_core_v41x.
common_rules.domains: serial 0.9 GHz: VM, SU s/n, HC s/n. stream 1.2 GHz: gather, capture, collective, selector, collector, svc, ctrl (cks; ckh HBM).

generator_gaps_common.what: hub buses vm->gather (512), capture->vm (512), collective->vm (512) connect a serial-domain slab and a stream-domain slab with a direct net (r9: common-clock stations): no CDC
generator_gaps_common.change: insert ratio-CDC end blocks (ot_ratio_cdc_fifo, format vr, as hx_*/hq_*) on those three buses, with a 3-b status back to the writer (capture: input 'ts', collective: 'ts')

generator_gaps_common.what: SU throughput: the S81 core issues SU ops on SUN = 256 lanes with 4 x 256 x 32 b operand reads a cycle; the die gives VM->SU 2 x 1024 b (64 elements/cycle, 16x narrower)
generator_gaps_common.change: COMPOSE must re-price every SU op at the hub-bus width, or the generator widens vm->su_s/su_n to 4 x 1024 b each (die count is not scarce); decision with the SU slab design (next step)

vm.function: the hub: the core's instruction sequencer + DYN/predicate/wait-mask issue + the vector memory + the spine x loader / broadcast (field x lanes xe/xw 565) + the query sender to the four scan services (qNE..qSW 513) + receivers of every unit's results
vm.rtl: sequencer/issue: ot_hdc_core_v41x (FSM, unit dispatch); x loader + broadcast: ot_v41_spine_w17w10 LOAD/STREAM (pqc successor owned by FIELD-SPINE); memory: no synthesizable 128-port VM exists (tile reg array is behavioural, not a fit claim); rtl/dsrom_sys/protected_vm/ot_dsrom_protected_vm.sv (5W/2R, 512-b rows, 64 x 4 ot_sram_1r1w_512x128 + check macros, SECDED) is the only real VM backend

die_ports.f_capture 512: VM write words from capture (capture contract)
die_ports.aNE..aSW 1027: svc attention output + index frames (2 x 513)
die_ports.xe/xw 565 + 3-b status: field x lane stream {x0 283, x1 266, cc 15} (spine broadcast format, ot_s81 column FIFO decode)

gaps: VM capacity: 256 x 64 Kb macros (16 Mb, VM_AW 19) = 1.33 mm2 of macros: fits the layer slab (2.66 mm2), NOT the head-die slab (0.89 mm2): head die needs its own capacity number
vm.next: design the hub memory system at the die-bus widths: banked 512-b-row VM (protected_vm backend pattern) with one port per hub bus + the core sequencer; size from the S81 per-die VM footprint (COMPOSE / L20 program); exact gate = the S81 L20 program on the core with the behavioural VM vs the slab

su.function: the stream/vector unit (X_SU = 1: ot_hdc_v41x_su_adapt -> ot_hdc_v41x_vec, N light lanes, M SFU lanes, LV reducer levels), half the lanes per slab
su.rtl: ot_hdc_v41x_vec / su_adapt (core); closed lane leaves owned by SU-FUSION (takeover-ds): su_hcpost lane, swiglu lane, norm sub-blocks, spsqrt lane; softmax PENDING_SSFF

die_ports.f_vm 1024: op descriptor (the core's su_* issue fields) + operand beats (32 elements/beat)

gaps: results go to HC, not the VM: the core writes SU results to the VM (xs_vm_we/xs_res); the S81 hub must route SU results VM-ward through HC (hc_n t_vm) -> HC needs a pass-through mode in its op set
su.next: after SU-FUSION lane margin views: slab top = registered broadcast tree (one stage per <= 400 um over 6.3 mm) + lane macros + reducer + return tree (HBM-die hfd_su generator tools/hbm_hub_quarter_gen.py is the physical pattern; its port mapping is NOT a functional contract and must not be reused as one)

hc.function: hyper-connection projection (X_HE = 1: ot_hdc_v41x_he_adapt -> ot_hdc_v41x_hcp, FP32 MAC lanes, weight banks) + mHC post (su_hcpost) + the SU->VM return path; the Sinkhorn is driven by the XU (ot_hdc_sinkhorn_mc), not HC
gaps: weight banks (hb_*: 8 banks x HHW x 32) have no die port: HC weights must be resident in the slab (ROM or loaded once per layer through f_vm)
split n/s across the crossing corridor: one logical unit in two blocks
hc.next: HC slab design after the HCP lane margin view; decide resident weights (ROM) vs streamed

svc.function: per-HBM-stack scan service: 16 attention tiles (ot_hdc_v41x_attn_tile_s / leaf ot_attn_hgrp_m6h1) + the stack's indexer key stream (ot_hdc_v41x_idx_kstream_ring + ring port) + the WINDOW sliding-window KV loader (rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_window_la, takeover-ds)

die_ports.ad 1026: attention output + index frames to the VM
die_ports.xd 514: index-score stream to the selector (selector contract)

gaps: no request path svc -> ctrl (ctrl contract adds it)
svc.state: CONTRACT ONLY (depends on WINDOW closure, takeover-ds, and an attention-tile margin view: leaf SS +18.9 / FF +1.5, below +40/+15)
svc.next: hierarchical slab: hardened attention tiles + idx reader + WINDOW as macros, registered distribution of q and rd; route after the leaves have margin views

collector.function: combines the four stacks' attention partials (cNE..cSW 515) into the attention output for the VM (vd 514 + vf forwarded clock)
collector.rtl: NONE for a cross-stack partial-attention merge (no LSE/max-rescale combine RTL found); ot_chip_v41x_ckv_die_service_cr is the CKV selected-row service (VM/HBM/all-gather ports), a different function
gaps: the combine arithmetic must match the golden attention (the core attention engine computes over all selected rows in one pass): a split-softmax merge changes the FP32 summation order -> not bit-exact with the core unless the partial format is {exact max, unnormalised sums} and the golden is re-derived
die_top_lint note 'banked collector: only its SRAM body has a retained macro abstract': no macro named
collector.state: CONTRACT ONLY: needs an arithmetic decision (exactness vs the golden) before RTL
collector.next: decide the partial format with the attention owner; if the golden cannot be matched, keep attention unsplit (all selected rows to one svc) and the collector becomes a row-gather FIFO
